newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Fernandez leaves for Davos forum.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Fernandez leaves for Davos forum.

text.p: Argentine Economy Minister Roque Fernandez left Buenos Aires on Monday to visit bankers in Zurich and Paris before attending the World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, later this week.
The minister will meet Swiss bankers at the Zurich office of Credit Suisse bank Wednesday then attend a seminary of the Inter-American Development Bank on Latin America in Paris Thursday.

During the Davos forum on the weekend, Fernandez will take part in debates chaired by economists Rudi Dornbusch and Jeffrey Sachs. He will be accompanied by aides including Industry Secretary Alieto Guadagni, as well as the heads of major Argentine businesses.

Fernandez's predecessor Domingo Cavallo, whom he replaced in July, will also be attending Davos as head of the private Argentine economic think-tank Fundacion Mediterranea, and as an advisor to Ecuadorean President Abdala Bucaram.
Fernandez is expected back in Argentina on Monday.
